name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport HR began after a career in corporate recruitment. Disenchanted with the cutthroat world of finance, he sought a role where passion and dedication were valued above all else. He found that in AF Corse, where he's built a reputation for spotting hidden talent and nurturing potential. Alistair believes in a 'firm but fair' approach, ensuring everyone feels valued and supported, while maintaining the high standards required to compete at the top level. His keen eye for detail and commitment to fairness make him a valuable asset to the team.

Before becoming an HR manager, Alistair was a recruiter for several high profile companies, so he is used to dealing with a variety of different personality types. He finds the motorsport world much more rewarding to work in however, as he is a massive fan of the sport himself. He has a particular passion for GT racing, often attending events in his spare time.

physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build with a serious but approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations
Starts every morning with a cup of Earl Grey tea, precisely brewed
Has an uncanny ability to remember everyone's birthday
